# CANDIDATE: REMOVE_BEARISH_FILL_BAR_GATE_BEARISH_REJECTION

**Filed:** 2026-09-08
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Removing the BEARISH_FILL_BAR gate (require_bearish_fill_bar) on the BEARISH_REJECTION setup will increase trade frequency and capture more of the bearish rejection edge, particularly on days where the fill bar is not bearish but the setup is otherwise valid. This gate may be filtering out valid entries under the current real-fills engine.

## Mechanism

The BEARISH_FILL_BAR gate requires that the entry bar (the trigger bar) has a bearish fill (close < open) for the BEARISH_REJECTION setup. Removing this gate will allow entries regardless of the fill bar's direction, as long as the other trigger conditions (level rejection, EMA ribbon flip, confluence) are met. Entry, stop, and target logic remain unchanged.
